item.title: Okaa-san no Ama Ama Time ~Issho ni Yoru no Kenshuu Massage~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Mamma Mia!
  • 発売日: 2015-10-16
  • スコア: 5.84/10 (21 人評価)
  • 日本語名: お母さんの甘々タイム ～一緒に夜の研修マッサージ～
  • 英語名: Okaa-san no Ama Ama Time Issho ni Yoru no Kenshuu Massage

あらすじ

The protagonist’s father died when he was young, and he was raised by his mother, a nurse, as a single mother. She is kind, cheerful, and has a lovely body. She has been his ideal woman since he was a child.

He became a doctor because he wanted to be with his mother as much as possible by working at the same hospital. He says, “I’m so happy to be working in the same hospital with you”.
